variants.prompt: On a luxurious yacht deck at dusk, this refined woman exudes sensuality, her raven tresses flowing freely as she reclines on a plush chaise, the setting sun casting a warm, golden glow across her porcelain skin and emerald eyes. Her charcoal coat and crisp white blouse have been shed, revealing a sheer black lace negligee that clings to her curves, a diamond brooch glittering at her throat. As she lazily extends a leg, the fabric rides up to expose a tantalizing expanse of thigh.
